sources.minimumLateral: Singapore NA (SS EN 1992-1-1 / SS EN 1990 NA): the design horizontal load at each floor not less than 1.5 % of the characteristic dead weight above it; SAEngine applies it as the least characteristic wind storey force (WX, WY), the combinations then factor it like the wind (on the safe side)
